newsitem.title: usa: ALPINE SKIING-CLAUDIA RIEGLER WINS WOMEN'S SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-CLAUDIA RIEGLER WINS WOMEN'S SLALOM.

text.p: Claudia Riegler of New Zealand won the season's first women's World Cup slalom Saturday, holding off Pernilla Wiberg of Sweden in a eyeblink finish.
Riegler, winning for the second time in her career, had a combined time of 1:36.50. Wiberg was clocked in 1:36.57.

A brilliant second run earned third place for Ingrid Salvenmoser of Austria, timed in 1:37.49. Patricia Chauvet of France finished fourth and Sabine Egger of Austria fifth, just ahead of Italy's Deborah Compagnoni.
